In the autumn of the gengwu year of Longqing [1570], Fujian was due to hold its Provincial Examination. The censor, acting upon an imperial edict, reiterated and enforced the regulations, with still greater reverence and rigor than before. When the work was completed, I, Daxun, unworthy though I am, having served after the other officials, was entitled by customary practice to append a postface to the closing pages.

I venture to say that worthy and wise men, at birth, receive their talents from Heaven and are endowed with the vital energies of the earth; they put these gifts to use in service to the ruler. When Heaven’s cycles converge favorably, they flourish; when the land’s configuration is spiritually potent, they are outstanding. When the ruler’s Way flourishes, they can fully realize what they have to offer. This is the broad pattern throughout past and present.

The Eight Min [Fujian] lay within the territory of ancient Yangzhou. Bordering the sea and threaded by rivers [?], its solitary peaks and towering mountains possess a beauty unsurpassed under Heaven. Can the extraordinary energies concentrated here produce nothing beyond salt, iron, gold-bearing sands, jasmine, and tall bamboo? Among its people, men of grand vision and exceptional capacity have made their names in succession. Some, impassioned in their concern for the times and standing alone in their integrity …

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
自遂或深沉莊重明習故常
或耿介絕羣清標離俗或委
身經略方戍朝廷或繼堯舜
周孔之傳或衍春秋皇極之
學求之唐宋間已褒然顯矣
明興人文益賁濟濟彬彬未易屈
指數今
===
皇上嗣位百度咸貞納言官儒臣
之
請開
恩選增科額
夢寐英賢如饑如渴非君子嚮
用日耶矧序當薦期歲屬庚
午陰陽之運尤為不偶何者
punctuated:
自遂，或深沉莊重，明習故常；或耿介絕羣，清標離俗；或委身經略，方戍朝廷；或繼堯舜周孔之傳，或衍春秋皇極之學。求之唐宋間，已褒然顯矣。明興，人文益賁，濟濟彬彬，未易屈指數。
今皇上嗣位，百度咸貞，納言官儒臣之請，開恩選，增科額，夢寐英賢，如饑如渴，非君子嚮用日耶？矧序當薦期，歲屬庚午，陰陽之運尤為不偶。何者？
translation_en:
…pursuing their aims independently; some were profound and dignified, thoroughly versed in established precedents; some were upright and stood apart from the crowd, their lofty character transcending worldly ways; some devoted themselves to strategic administration and frontier defense in service to the court [?]; some continued the tradition of Yao, Shun, the Duke of Zhou, and Confucius; and some elaborated the learning of the Spring and Autumn Annals and the Supreme Standard (Huangji). Such men can already be found prominently distinguished during the Tang and Song. With the rise of the Ming, cultural accomplishment became still more brilliant: accomplished men abounded, too numerous to count readily on one's fingers.
Now that His Majesty has succeeded to the throne, all institutions have been set right. He has accepted the requests of remonstrance officials and Confucian court officials, graciously authorized an additional selection, and increased the examination quota. He dreams of outstanding and worthy men, longing for them as one hungers for food and thirsts for drink. Is this not the day when gentlemen find favor and employment? Moreover, the season has come for recommending candidates, and the year is gengwu: the operation of yin and yang is especially extraordinary. Why is this? …

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
天地生生之數實在庚中元
之氣盛在午故庚於五行爲
金有從革之義焉蓋說文以
庚爲更也意者其人文丕變
之時乎午於月令爲火有離
明之象焉蓋律呂以午爲蕤
賓也意者其利用賓王之會
===
乎夫槩封疆之全可以徵地
靈察歲德之隆可以占
昌運惟茲多士豈無洪猷偉器
如古者以應
大君側席之求哉上續皐陶之歌
下述王褒之頌士生斯世而
得遇
punctuated: 天地生生之數，實在庚；中元之氣，盛在午。故庚於五行爲金，有從革之義焉。蓋《說文》以庚爲更也，意者其人文丕變之時乎？午於月令爲火，有離明之象焉。蓋律呂以午爲蕤賓也，意者其利用賓王之會乎？夫槩封疆之全，可以徵地靈；察歲德之隆，可以占昌運。惟茲多士，豈無洪猷偉器如古者，以應大君側席之求哉？上續皐陶之歌，下述王褒之頌。士生斯世，而得遇
translation_en: The numerical principle by which Heaven and Earth continually engender life resides in geng; the vital force of the middle cycle reaches its fullness in wu. Thus, among the Five Phases, geng corresponds to metal and carries the meaning of yielding to transformation. The Explanation of Graphs and Analysis of Characters (Shuowen) explains geng as “renewal.” Might this, then, be a time of great transformation in cultural achievement? In the Monthly Ordinances, wu corresponds to fire and bears the image of Li, brightness. In the system of pitch standards, wu corresponds to Ruibin, “Luxuriant Guest.” Might this, then, be the occasion when “it is beneficial to be a guest of the king”? Surveying the whole territory, one can discern the land’s numinous potency; observing the abundance of the year’s virtue, one can divine a flourishing destiny. Among these many scholars, surely there are men of grand designs and outstanding capacity, like those of antiquity, who can answer the great ruler’s eager search for worthy men. They may carry forward the song of Gao Yao from high antiquity and emulate the eulogy of Wang Bao from a later age. For a scholar to be born into this age and have the opportunity to encounter …

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
明天子幸矣顧諸士亦知所以自
靖乎耕人織婦以業爲供販
夫賈子以貨爲稅乃稻黍枲
絲甝珠金錯丹漆玄黃之屬
姑無論卽微如齒毛羽革有
一不登
天府待財用耶而士獨以聲律
===
比耦之技
獻罔當世用視農賈不其有餘
赧哉夫人臣懷以人事
君之忠而僅惟手空文以求士士
人抱適用之學而僅亦以空
文售知於人乃今多士以文
進矣其自許云何夫處則綜
punctuated: 明天子，幸矣！顧諸士亦知所以自靖乎？耕人織婦以業爲供，販夫賈子以貨爲稅。乃稻黍枲絲、甝珠金錯、丹漆玄黃之屬，姑無論；卽微如齒毛羽革，有一不登天府待財用耶？而士獨以聲律比耦之技獻，罔當世用，視農賈，不其有餘赧哉？夫人臣懷以人事君之忠，而僅惟手空文以求士；士人抱適用之學，而僅亦以空文售知於人。乃今多士以文進矣，其自許云何？夫處則綜
translation_en: …an enlightened Son of Heaven—how fortunate! Yet do you gentlemen also know how to discharge your duties with a clear conscience? Ploughmen and weaving women provide contributions through their occupations; traders and merchants pay taxes on their goods. Let us leave aside such things as rice and millet, hemp and silk, pearls [?] and inlaid gold, cinnabar and lacquer, and black and yellow pigments. Even among such humble things as teeth, hair, feathers, and hides, is there a single item that does not enter the imperial treasury to meet its material needs? Yet scholars alone present their skill in tonal patterns and parallel phrasing, offering nothing suited to the needs of the age. Compared with farmers and merchants, ought they not to feel deeply ashamed? Ministers cherish the loyal intention of serving their ruler by supplying worthy men, yet merely handle empty compositions [?] in seeking scholars; scholars possess learning suited to practical use, yet likewise seek recognition from others merely through empty compositions. Now you gentlemen have advanced through literary composition: what do you pledge yourselves to accomplish? When living in retirement, you should comprehensively study…

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
圖校史嚌躋聖眞出則抱功
脩職澤加品庶皆吾分內事
詎謂以文進遂以文用耶且
昔之所謂洪猷偉器者始進
孰不以文厥後功懋當時聲
施來葉無復以空文病之今
其人遠矣其事識在長老諸
===
士盍往諮之反之身心假令
今歲隨計吏來歲試春官授
以中外政其抉膽獻圖能如
鄭俠乎剖赤條畫能如曾公
亮乎抗顏停草能如楊億乎
智周經濟忠切時艱能如李
綱乎距詖放淫閑先開後能
punctuated: 圖校史，嚌躋聖眞；出則抱功脩職，澤加品庶，皆吾分內事。詎謂以文進，遂以文用耶？且昔之所謂洪猷偉器者，始進孰不以文？厥後功懋當時，聲施來葉，無復以空文病之。今其人遠矣，其事識在長老，諸士盍往諮之，反之身心？假令今歲隨計吏，來歲試春官，授以中外政，其抉膽獻圖，能如鄭俠乎？剖赤條畫，能如曾公亮乎？抗顏停草，能如楊億乎？智周經濟，忠切時艱，能如李綱乎？距詖放淫，閑先開後，能
translation_en:
…charts and collate histories, ascending to the truth of the sages [?]; upon entering office, undertake achievements [?] and fulfill official duties, extending benefits to the common people—all these are our allotted responsibilities. How could advancement through literary composition mean that one is then employed solely for literary composition? Moreover, among those men of former times celebrated for their grand designs and extraordinary capacities, who did not first advance through literary composition? Thereafter, their achievements distinguished their age, and their fame reached later generations; no one again reproached them for empty writing. Those men are now distant from us, but knowledge of their deeds remains among the elders. Why do you gentlemen not go and consult them, and apply what you learn to your own conduct and minds?
Suppose that this year you accompany the officials conveying the accounts to the capital, next year sit the examination at the Ministry of Rites, and are then entrusted with administration in the capital or the provinces. In baring your heart and presenting an illustration, can you equal Zheng Xia? In laying bare your loyal heart and setting out detailed plans, can you equal Zeng Gongliang? In maintaining a resolute countenance and refusing to continue drafting, can you equal Yang Yi? In wisdom encompassing the ordering of the realm, and loyalty urgently directed toward the difficulties of the times, can you equal Li Gang? In resisting biased doctrines, banishing extravagant teachings, safeguarding the learning of your predecessors, and opening the way for those who follow, can you…

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
如楊如羅如李如朱如胡氏
兄弟蔡氏父子乎方爾淹迹
草茅屏居自計謂天下事輒
有言之未可行之無由而掩
卷咨嗟思以身代之而莫得
其便者行將事事矣可弗訪
前脩圖厥終耶夫溺利易趨
===
者庸棄其平生和俗取容者
間變其初志釣名沽譽者終
不厭於眾情守寂空談者多
無得於實際而砥礪過激者
尚或歉於中行於此有一焉
豈惟若人羞之諺曰腐螢不
提一筐盡染彼二三子者能
punctuated: 如楊、如羅、如李、如朱、如胡氏兄弟、蔡氏父子乎？方爾淹迹草茅，屏居自計，謂天下事輒有言之未可、行之無由，而掩卷咨嗟，思以身代之而莫得其便者，行將事事矣，可弗訪前脩、圖厥終耶？夫溺利易趨者，庸棄其平生；和俗取容者，間變其初志；釣名沽譽者，終不厭於眾情；守寂空談者，多無得於實際；而砥礪過激者，尚或歉於中行。於此有一焉，豈惟若人羞之？諺曰：「腐螢不提，一筐盡染。」彼二三子者，能
translation_en:
…like Yang, Luo, Li, Zhu, the Hu brothers, or the Cai father and son? While you have lingered in obscurity, living secluded lives and reflecting to yourselves, you have thought that among the affairs of the realm there were always matters about which you could not yet speak and upon which you had no means to act. Closing your books with sighs, you wished to take the place of those responsible, but found no opportunity. Soon you will be attending to these very affairs. Can you fail to inquire into the worthy predecessors and plan how to carry your purpose through to the end?
Those immersed in profit and readily drawn after it commonly abandon their lifelong principles [?]; those who accommodate prevailing customs to gain acceptance sometimes alter their original resolve; those who angle for fame and purchase praise ultimately fail to satisfy public sentiment; those who remain in seclusion and engage in empty talk mostly achieve nothing in practical affairs; and those who press self-discipline to extremes may still fall short of conduct that keeps to the mean. If any one of these faults is present, would the shame belong to that person alone? As the proverb says, “If a rotten firefly [?] is not removed, the whole basket becomes tainted.” Could those gentlemen …

title: 隆慶四年福建鄉試錄
text:
無緣一不檢者而槩目爲敗
羣哉爾其矢志宣猷交相勸
勉毋沿今習毋謝昔軌帱之
帷席措之巖廊勿使背而馳
若兩人焉果爾則仰足以當
天運俯足以應地靈上之不負
天子下之不誤蒼生卽八閩山川
===
且有華色而大勳等以人事
君之忠庶幾可慰藉萬一矣諸士
其重念之哉
直隸松江府儒學敎授夏大
勳謹序
punctuated:
無緣一不檢者而槩目爲敗羣哉？爾其矢志宣猷，交相勸勉，毋沿今習，毋謝昔軌。帱之帷席，措之巖廊，勿使背而馳，若兩人焉。果爾，則仰足以當天運，俯足以應地靈，上之不負天子，下之不誤蒼生。卽八閩山川且有華色，而大勳等以人事君之忠，庶幾可慰藉萬一矣。諸士其重念之哉！
直隸松江府儒學敎授夏大勳謹序。
translation_en:
…avoid being indiscriminately branded a corrupt company because of a single member’s misconduct? You should resolve firmly to advance worthy plans and encourage one another. Do not follow present-day habits or abandon the exemplary ways of the past. Whether sheltered behind curtains and mats [?] or placed in the halls of government, do not let your conduct take opposite courses, as though you were two different people. If you do this, you will be worthy of Heaven’s workings above and responsive to the earth’s spiritual potency below; you will neither fail the Son of Heaven above nor lead the common people astray below. Even the mountains and rivers of the Eight Min regions of Fujian will gain new lustre. Then our loyal efforts—mine, Daxun’s, and those of my colleagues—to serve the sovereign by presenting worthy men may receive some small measure of consolation. Let all you scholars ponder this earnestly!
Preface respectfully composed by Xia Daxun, Professor of the Confucian School of Songjiang Prefecture in the directly administered metropolitan region.
